content: Yesu aravuga ati: “Naje muri iyi si kuba agahinyuza, ngo abatabona babone, n'ababona babe impumyi.”

teaching.description: Yesu akora igitangaza mu gukiza umuntu yari yavutse ar’impumyi.Abayuda aho gushima ico gitangaza; baciye barushiriza kwanka Yesu.Naho Yesu yari yaje azanye umuco w’isi kandi nawe nyene ubwiwe ari umuco w’isi, benshi bashimye kuguma mu mwiza, bagumana ivyaha vyabo.
teaching.name: Babaza uwahora ari impumyi ingene yahumutse.

content: Bamwe mu Bafarisayo bari kumwe na we bumvise ivyo bati: “Mbega natwe turi impumyi?”

teaching.description: Yesu akora igitangaza mu gukiza umuntu yari yavutse ar’impumyi.Abayuda aho gushima ico gitangaza; baciye barushiriza kwanka Yesu.Naho Yesu yari yaje azanye umuco w’isi kandi nawe nyene ubwiwe ari umuco w’isi, benshi bashimye kuguma mu mwiza, bagumana ivyaha vyabo.
teaching.name: Babaza uwahora ari impumyi ingene yahumutse.

content: Yesu arababwira ati: “Iyo muba mwari impumyi, nta caha muba mufise, ariko noneho muvuga muti: 'Turabona, icaha canyu camaho.”
